program_narrative: TSTGEN00 is a batch test-data generator driven by a configuration file. It opens the configuration file TEST-CONFIG and the random-seed file RANDOM-SEED for input and the output files PORTFOLIO-OUT (PORTFLIO layout) and TRANSACTION-OUT (TRNREC layout), reports any open failure through 9999-ERROR-HANDLER, reads a seed value and clears its counters. The main loop reads TEST-CONFIG until end of file; for each configuration record it selects the generator by CFG-TEST-TYPE: 'PORTFOLIO' and 'TRANSACTN' run a counted loop of CFG-VOLUME iterations that generates and writes portfolio or transaction records, 'ERROR' generates data-error and process-error cases, 'VOLUME' generates large portfolio and transaction volumes, and any other type is reported as 'INVALID TEST TYPE'. The paragraphs that actually build and write the records (2210, 2220, 2310, 2320, 2410, 2420, 2510, 2520) are not in this source, so the generated content cannot be described. At the end all four files are closed. Error handling: each error is counted and displayed on the console; after more than 100 errors the program sets RETURN-CODE 12 and ends.

paragraphs.name: 2100-GENERATE-TEST-DATA
pseudocode: -- Dispatch on the configured test type
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Dispatch on the configured test type
SELECT CASE config_test_type
  WHEN 'PORTFOLIO':  -- WS-PORTFOLIO
    CALL 2200-gen-portfolio
  WHEN 'TRANSACTN':  -- WS-TRANSACTION
    CALL 2300-gen-transaction
  WHEN 'ERROR':  -- WS-ERROR-TEST
    CALL 2400-gen-error-data
  WHEN 'VOLUME':  -- WS-VOLUME-TEST
    CALL 2500-gen-volume-data
  ELSE:
    SET error_message = 'INVALID TEST TYPE'
    CALL 9999-error-handler
END SELECT
